requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Printing Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer targeting unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs, designed for 5-250 employees, 6-15 printers per business, and AMPV ~500 pages. The printer must deliver high ROI, efficiency, and require minimal IT intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a new, untapped SMB segment with cost-effective, low-intervention printing, filling a portfolio gap (CISS PLE Hi).
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires support for tank technology, CISS PLE Hi segment, and SMB-specific manageability features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: A business ink tank printer is launched with features and performance aligned to the SMB target group (5-250 employees, 6-15 printers, AMPV ~500), and can be used without dedicated IT support.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and printer manageability solutions, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, to make business operations easier for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need easy-to-use, intelligent solutions to maximize productivity and reduce manual intervention.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration and compatibility with hardware and SMB portal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features such as Perfect Print and Perfect Scan are available, functional, and demonstrably improve workflow efficiency in SMB environments.

requirements.Title: SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal (SMB portal) for managing multiple printers, tailored for office managers and generalist IT users in SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT; a user-friendly portal is essential for efficient multi-device management.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal software development and integration with printer firmware and AI features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is live, supports management of 6-15 printers, and is usable by non-IT trained staff (office managers/generalists).

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan has HP's lowest business TCO among SMB tank printers, through efficient ink usage, minimal maintenance, and sustainable design.
requirements.Rationale: TCO is a key purchase driver for SMBs seeking ROI and efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires efficient ink tank design, low maintenance, and sustainability features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent testing confirms Magellan's TCO is lowest among HP business tank printers for SMB use cases.

requirements.Title: Customer-Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be customer-replaceable, with a target for replacement outside warranty at service centers if necessary.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and service costs for SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware design supporting easy maintenance box replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by end users without HP technician intervention, as validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure proper maintenance of the ink tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and maintenance issues, improving reliability for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires supply chain and hardware compatibility with keyed bottles.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottles are keyed and only fit the correct tanks, as confirmed by hardware validation.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU Features
requirements.Description: For the Non-PDL SKU, include support for SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS (Printing as a Service).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses different SMB needs and supports new service models.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and hardware support for these features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU is available with SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View, and PaaS integration.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Features
requirements.Description: For the PDL SKU, deliver improved print speeds (25/20 ppm), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Targets higher-end SMBs needing advanced printing and regulatory compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware/firmware for speed and PDL/PS, and Blue Angel certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves 25/20 ppm, supports PDL/PS, and is Blue Angel certified.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% RCP Content
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer is built with at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and market demand for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and manufacturing with high RCP.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is independently verified to use at least 60% RCP in its construction.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty of 80k pages or 2 years (whichever comes first), with serviceability features: PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center, if out of warranty).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and reduces SMB downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware/service design for warranty and customer replaceability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty and serviceability model is implemented and documented; validated by service/support teams.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect usage, performance, and error data for remote diagnostics and product improvement.
requirements.Rationale: Supports proactive support, quality improvements, and future product enhancements.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires secure telemetry software and privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry is active, securely transmits key metrics, and is accessible to HP support/engineering teams.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Support mobile printing and seamless integration with the HP App for print, scan, and device management.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile workflows are increasingly important for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print/scan/manage devices via the HP App on iOS/Android.

requirements.Title: Solutions/Services Monetization
requirements.Description: Enable monetization of AI and management solutions/services as part of the Magellan offering over the next 3-5 years.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's business goal for sustainable revenue growth via services.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires business model and technical enablement for solution monetization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions/services are available for purchase or subscription, with revenue tracking in place.
